Learned Index Lab: Replacing B-Trees with streaming linear models in pure Rust (-99% RAM, 3x faster)
item.description: Instead of pointer-chasing through B-Tree node hierarchies, this index models the key distribution using streaming piecewise linear regression with strict epsilon error bounds. (1 source: rprogramming)
